description: Language-neutral vectors of the expensive-unit rule (`finals` of the offload policy): a unit is expensive when its predicted local compile time (recorded, else for a linked wasm unit the family estimate over the recorded compile times of the `_component` crates, else the seed) reaches `minimumMilliseconds`, or its placed peak (counted for a unit with a learned peak or a linked wasm unit) reaches `minimumMegabytes`. `state` is the cost folder of one crate, `expect` what placement and the gate read from it.

cases.name: an ordinary unit never measured is not expensive: the unknown default says nothing
an ordinary unit of 119.999 s stays
an ordinary unit of exactly 120 s is expensive
a cheap ordinary unit with a learned peak below the memory threshold stays
a cheap ordinary unit whose learned peak places at 4096 MB is expensive
a linked wasm final never measured, no family: the seed makes it expensive and it is placed at the cold bound
a linked wasm final with two family crates measured is still seeded
a linked wasm final whose family of three small finals was measured is cheap in time and memory: it stays here
a linked wasm final whose family is big in time is expensive by the family estimate
a linked wasm final whose family is big in memory only is expensive by memory
a measured small linked final stays whatever its family says
a measured big linked final is expensive by its own record
